our-lady.index.title: Our Lady of Kibeho
our-lady.index.subtitle: The message of conversion, prayer, and reconciliation
our-lady.index.intro: Discover the Marian apparitions at Kibeho — the first and, to date, the only Marian apparition site in Africa officially recognised by the Catholic Church.

our-lady.apparitions.title: The Apparitions
our-lady.apparitions.subtitle: 1981–1989 · Kibeho, Rwanda
our-lady.apparitions.intro: Between 1981 and 1989, the Blessed Virgin Mary appeared in Kibeho under the name Nyina wa Jambo — Mother of the Word. The apparitions called the Church and the world to conversion, prayer, and reconciliation.

items: A call to conversion of heart and sincere prayer
A prophetic invitation to reconciliation and peace
Recognition of the authenticity of the apparitions by the Church

our-lady.visionaries.title: The Visionaries
our-lady.visionaries.subtitle: Those who received the message
our-lady.visionaries.intro: The Church recognised the authenticity of the apparitions associated with three visionaries of Kibeho. Their witness continues to invite pilgrims to listen to the Mother of the Word.

items.title: Alphonsine Mumureke
items.text: The first visionary; apparitions began on 28 November 1981.

items.title: Nathalie Mukamazimpaka
items.text: Called to a life of prayer, penance, and redemptive suffering.

items.title: Marie Claire Mukangango
items.text: Associated especially with the devotion of the Seven Sorrows Rosary.

our-lady.messages.title: The Messages
our-lady.messages.subtitle: Mother of the Word
our-lady.messages.intro: Our Lady of Kibeho invites conversion of the heart, the prayer of the Rosary — especially the Seven Sorrows — and a life of love, repentance, and reconciliation.

items: Convert while there is still time
Pray the Rosary and the Seven Sorrows Rosary
Love one another and seek reconciliation
Live the Gospel with humility and fidelity

our-lady.church-recognition.title: Church Recognition
our-lady.church-recognition.subtitle: Declared authentic by the Catholic Church
our-lady.church-recognition.intro: The Diocese of Gikongoro, after careful investigation, declared the apparitions of Kibeho authentic. Kibeho is the first — and to date the only — Marian apparition site in Africa officially recognised by the Church.

our-lady.history.title: History
our-lady.history.subtitle: From the apparitions to the shrine today
our-lady.history.intro: From the first apparitions in 1981 through Church recognition and the growth of pilgrimage, Kibeho has become a place of prayer for Rwanda and for the universal Church.

items: 2001 — Declaration of authenticity by the Bishop of Gikongoro
Today — An international shrine welcoming pilgrims worldwide

our-lady.faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
our-lady.faq.subtitle: About Our Lady of Kibeho and the Shrine
our-lady.faq.intro: Answers to common questions about the apparitions, recognition by the Church, pilgrimage, and life at the Shrine.

items.title: Are the apparitions recognised?
items.text: Yes. The Catholic Church has declared authentic the apparitions associated with the three recognised visionaries of Kibeho.

items.title: Who can visit the Shrine?
items.text: Pilgrims from Rwanda and every nation are welcome. Groups are encouraged to contact the Pilgrimage Office in advance.

items.title: What is the main message?
items.text: Conversion, prayer (especially the Rosary and Seven Sorrows), and reconciliation — living the Gospel with sincerity.

items.title: How can I support the Shrine?
items.text: Through prayer, pilgrimage, partnership, and donations toward pastoral life and the Master Plan.

shrine.index.title: The Shrine
shrine.index.subtitle: A place of prayer, liturgy, and Marian devotion
shrine.index.intro: Explore the churches, apparition sites, Holy Spring, Way of the Cross, and liturgical life of the Shrine of Our Lady of Kibeho.

shrine.welcome.title: Welcome
shrine.welcome.subtitle: You are welcome at Kibeho
shrine.welcome.intro: The Shrine of Our Lady of Kibeho welcomes pilgrims from Rwanda and around the world. Come to pray, to celebrate the sacraments, and to encounter the Mother of the Word.

shrine.churches.title: Churches
shrine.churches.subtitle: Places of worship at the Shrine
shrine.churches.intro: Discover the churches and chapels that serve the liturgical and pastoral life of the Shrine of Our Lady of Kibeho.

shrine.apparition-sites.title: Apparition Sites
shrine.apparition-sites.subtitle: Where Our Lady appeared
shrine.apparition-sites.intro: Visit the places associated with the apparitions of Our Lady of Kibeho — spaces of silence, prayer, and remembrance of the Mother of the Word.

shrine.holy-spring.title: Holy Spring
shrine.holy-spring.subtitle: The Water of Kibeho
shrine.holy-spring.intro: Pilgrims come to the Holy Spring in faith — a sign of God’s grace and a call to interior purification and trust.

shrine.way-of-the-cross.title: Way of the Cross
shrine.way-of-the-cross.subtitle: Walking with Christ
shrine.way-of-the-cross.intro: Pray the Way of the Cross at the Shrine — a path of meditation on the Passion of Christ in the company of Our Lady of Sorrows.

shrine.eucharistic-adorations.title: Eucharistic Adorations
shrine.eucharistic-adorations.subtitle: Stay with Me
shrine.eucharistic-adorations.intro: Join times of Eucharistic Adoration at the Shrine — silent prayer before the Blessed Sacrament, for personal intentions and for the world.

shrine.mass-schedule.title: Mass Schedule
shrine.mass-schedule.subtitle: Liturgical life of the Shrine
shrine.mass-schedule.intro: Join the daily and festal celebration of Holy Mass at the Shrine of Our Lady of Kibeho. Schedules may vary on feast days and major pilgrimages — confirm with the Pilgrimage Office when planning a group visit.

items.title: Weekdays
items.text: Morning Mass — times announced locally and by the Pilgrimage Office.

items.title: Sundays & solemnities
items.text: Principal Masses for pilgrims and the local community.

items.title: Confessions
items.text: Available according to the pastoral schedule, especially before major celebrations.

items.title: Feast days
items.text: Extended liturgy during Marian feasts and national or international pilgrimages.

shrine.map.title: Shrine Map
shrine.map.subtitle: Find your way around the Shrine
shrine.map.intro: An interactive map of the Shrine grounds is planned. For now, ask at the Pilgrimage Office for orientation to churches, apparition sites, the Holy Spring, and pilgrim facilities.

pilgrimage.index.title: Pilgrimage
pilgrimage.index.subtitle: Prepare your journey to Kibeho
pilgrimage.index.intro: Whether you come alone, with family, or with a parish group, the Shrine welcomes you. Prepare spiritually and practically for your pilgrimage.

pilgrimage.why-kibeho.title: Why Kibeho?
pilgrimage.why-kibeho.subtitle: A recognised Marian shrine in Africa
pilgrimage.why-kibeho.intro: Pilgrims come to Kibeho to encounter Our Lady, Mother of the Word — to pray for conversion, peace, and reconciliation, and to renew their life in Christ.

items.title: Recognised by the Church
items.text: The only Marian apparition site in Africa officially recognised by the Catholic Church.

items.title: A call to conversion
items.text: The message of Kibeho invites a sincere return to God and to one another.

items.title: A living shrine
items.text: Liturgy, prayer, and hospitality for pilgrims from every nation.

pilgrimage.plan.title: Plan your Pilgrimage
pilgrimage.plan.subtitle: Spiritual and practical preparation
pilgrimage.plan.intro: Prepare your heart through prayer, and organise travel, accommodation, and liturgy with the Pilgrimage Office — especially for groups and international pilgrims.

items: Contact the Pilgrimage Office with dates and group size
Review practical guidelines for the Shrine

pilgrimage.accommodation.title: Accommodation
pilgrimage.accommodation.subtitle: Places to stay near the Shrine
pilgrimage.accommodation.intro: Find guest houses, retreat centres, and hotels near Kibeho. The Pilgrimage Office can advise groups on suitable options.

pilgrimage.transportation.title: Transportation
pilgrimage.transportation.subtitle: How to reach Kibeho
pilgrimage.transportation.intro: Kibeho is in Nyaruguru District, Southern Province, Rwanda. Pilgrims typically travel via Kigali or regional towns. Group organisers should plan transfers in advance.

items: International arrivals via Kigali International Airport
Local guidance available through the Pilgrimage Office

pilgrimage.office.title: Pilgrimage Office
pilgrimage.office.subtitle: Your first point of contact
pilgrimage.office.intro: The Pilgrimage Office assists individuals and groups with visit planning, liturgical arrangements, and practical questions about the Shrine.

items.title: International pilgrims
items.text: Guidance for travel, language, and pastoral accompaniment.

items.title: General enquiries
items.text: Mass times, shrine life, and visitor information.

pilgrimage.calendar.title: Pilgrimage Calendar
pilgrimage.calendar.subtitle: Feasts, gatherings, and registered pilgrimages
pilgrimage.calendar.intro: Follow major Marian feasts, national and international pilgrimages, and opportunities to join organised groups at the Shrine.

pilgrimage.practical-information.title: Practical Information
pilgrimage.practical-information.subtitle: What pilgrims need to know
pilgrimage.practical-information.intro: Guidelines for dress, conduct, photography, offerings, and the rhythm of prayer at the Shrine — so every visit remains reverent and fruitful.

items: Maintain silence in places of prayer
Follow guidance of shrine staff and security
Confirm group schedules with the Pilgrimage Office

spirituality.index.title: Spirituality
spirituality.index.subtitle: Pray with the Shrine — near or far
spirituality.index.intro: Deepen your spiritual life with the prayers, rosaries, novenas, and pastoral invitations of Our Lady of Kibeho. You may also send prayer intentions and request Masses.

spirituality.prayer-intentions.title: Prayer Intentions
spirituality.prayer-intentions.subtitle: Entrust your intentions to the prayer of the Shrine
spirituality.prayer-intentions.intro: Share prayer intentions with the Shrine community. Online intention submission will be expanded; for now, send your request through the Pilgrimage Office contact form.

spirituality.request-a-mass.title: Request a Mass
spirituality.request-a-mass.subtitle: Have Mass offered at the Shrine
spirituality.request-a-mass.intro: Request that Holy Mass be celebrated at the Shrine of Our Lady of Kibeho for your intention. A dedicated online Mass-request service is planned; meanwhile, contact the Pilgrimage Office.

spirituality.rosary.title: Rosary
spirituality.rosary.subtitle: Pray with Mary
spirituality.rosary.intro: Our Lady of Kibeho calls the faithful to pray the Rosary with faith and perseverance — a path of contemplation of the mysteries of Christ.

spirituality.seven-sorrows-rosary.title: Seven Sorrows Rosary
spirituality.seven-sorrows-rosary.subtitle: A devotion especially linked to Kibeho
spirituality.seven-sorrows-rosary.intro: Our Lady asked for the prayer of the Seven Sorrows Rosary — meditating on the sorrows of Mary and uniting our hearts to her Son.

items: The Loss of the Child Jesus in the Temple
Mary meets Jesus on the Way of the Cross
Mary receives the Body of Jesus

spirituality.novena.title: Novena
spirituality.novena.subtitle: Nine days of prayer with Our Lady of Kibeho
spirituality.novena.intro: Pray a novena to Our Lady of Kibeho for conversion, peace, healing, and the needs of the Church and the world.

spirituality.official-prayers.title: Official Prayers
spirituality.official-prayers.subtitle: Prayers of the Shrine
spirituality.official-prayers.intro: Official prayers associated with the Shrine of Our Lady of Kibeho — for personal devotion and communal prayer.

spirituality.meditations.title: Meditations
spirituality.meditations.subtitle: Reflect on the Word and the message of Kibeho
spirituality.meditations.intro: Spiritual meditations to accompany pilgrimage, the liturgical year, and daily prayer with Our Lady of Kibeho.

spirituality.testimonies.title: Testimonies
spirituality.testimonies.subtitle: Fruits of grace at Kibeho
spirituality.testimonies.intro: Pilgrims share how prayer at the Shrine has renewed faith, brought peace, and opened paths of reconciliation. Submit your testimony through the Pilgrimage Office.

news.videos.title: Videos
news.videos.subtitle: Watch and pray with the Shrine
news.videos.intro: Video messages, liturgical celebrations, and documentary material from the Shrine will be gathered here. Follow our YouTube channel and gallery for current media.

support.index.title: Support the Shrine
support.index.subtitle: Pastoral mission and sustainable development
support.index.intro: Unlike long-established pilgrimage sites, Kibeho is still developing. Your partnership helps proclaim the message, welcome pilgrims, and build the infrastructure of the Shrine for generations to come.

support.vision.title: Vision
support.vision.subtitle: The official digital and pastoral gateway of the Shrine
support.vision.intro: The Diocese of Gikongoro wishes the Shrine to welcome pilgrims from every nation, proclaim the message of Our Lady of Kibeho, and sustain long-term pastoral, spiritual, and infrastructural development.

support.master-plan.title: Master Plan
support.master-plan.subtitle: Building the future of the Shrine
support.master-plan.intro: The Master Plan guides future infrastructure, pilgrim hospitality, pastoral facilities, and environmental care at Kibeho. Detailed plans and project phases will be published here as they are approved.

support.projects.title: Current Projects
support.projects.subtitle: Works underway at the Shrine
support.projects.intro: Follow current pastoral and infrastructure projects that sustain the life of the Shrine and improve the welcome of pilgrims.

support.donations.title: Donations
support.donations.subtitle: Support the mission and development of the Shrine
support.donations.intro: Your gift helps welcome pilgrims, sustain liturgy and pastoral care, and advance the Master Plan. Online payment integration is planned; bank and diocesan channels are available via the Pilgrimage Office.

support.annual-reports.title: Annual Reports
support.annual-reports.subtitle: Accountability to pilgrims and partners
support.annual-reports.intro: Annual reports of the Shrine and related development initiatives will be published here to keep the faithful and partners informed.

support.transparency.title: Transparency
support.transparency.subtitle: Trust in the service of the Gospel
support.transparency.intro: The Diocese of Gikongoro is committed to transparent stewardship of gifts received for the Shrine — with clear reporting on pastoral priorities and development projects.

support.partners.title: Partners
support.partners.subtitle: Walking together with the Shrine
support.partners.intro: Parishes, religious communities, dioceses, and friends of Kibeho worldwide support the mission through prayer, pilgrimage, and collaboration. Contact us to explore partnership.

faq.index.subtitle: Common questions
faq.index.intro: See the FAQ under Our Lady of Kibeho for answers about the apparitions, recognition, and visiting the Shrine.
